findings.title: Replay freezes the ESM chess.js file, not the file Node actually resolves
findings.evidence: runtime_identity hardcodes node_modules/chess.js/dist/esm/chess.js. src/chess.mjs imports bare chess.js; its package main is dist/cjs/chess.js and there is no exports override. Actual read-only node import.meta.resolve probe returned file:///home/hermes/projects/astra-chess/node_modules/chess.js/dist/cjs/chess.js. The CJS file is absent from runtime_identity paths. A changed loaded CJS implementation can therefore escape both before/after identity checks while the unused ESM file remains fixed. Package metadata/lock hashes do not prove installed CJS bytes.
findings.requestedChange: Do not edit the running wrapper in place, as it is itself hash-bound. Preserve this attempt with its narrower limitation. Before an accepted separately named confirmation, resolve chess.js from the actual source importer using Node resolution and hash that resolved file (and relevant imported local files), as well as any browser ESM file desired. Add a non-mocked negative coverage test proving the resolved CJS file is included and a byte change is rejected. A current receipt alone cannot close this omitted-byte binding.

checks.limit: Both tests patch runtime_identity; they prove equality rejection, not coverage of actual loaded runtime files.
